Q.name: Quartermaster Dov Harrow
lines: Hold's a mess, I know where everything is. Mostly.
Bring me salvage, I'll bring you creds.
Don't lean on the reactor housing. She bites.
Prices are fixed. Doesn't mean we can't haggle.
Q.title: Quartermaster
Q.bark: Mind the crates. They bite back.

kessar:queen: Bug guts on my deck plates. Wipe your boots, hero.

T.name: Signals Tech Ines Ruhl
lines: Anything you pull out of the dark comes back scrambled. I'll unscramble it, once the rig's up.
Decoder bank's still warming up. Give me time.
If a piece of gear starts humming at you, bring it straight to me. Don't listen to it.
I found a dead channel that only plays rain. Isn't that nice?
T.title: Signals Tech

kessar:queen: The hive was talking, you know. All that chittering. I recorded some. For science.

M.name: Medic Oskar Venn
lines: Sit. Bleed quietly. I'll get to you.
I lost my licence on Thessaly. I didn't lose my hands.
Come back in one piece. Fewer pieces, more paperwork.
revive_lines: Easy. Easy. You were dead for a bit. Don't make a habit of it.
The Cradle put you back together. Mostly the right way round.
Welcome back. That's another one I'm not filing paperwork for.
M.title: Medic
M.bark: Bleeding? Over here. Not on the floor.

revived_once: You've been in my Cradle once already. It remembers you. That should worry you more than it does.
kessar:queen: Acid burns, bite wounds, and something growing in your boot. Standard.

F.name: Kesh, a fence
lines: Passenger. Strictly passenger. Don't ask what's in the crates.
Sealed salvage, friend. Could be junk. Could be a fortune. Probably a fortune.
Customs officers? Never met one. Lovely people, I hear.
F.title: Fence

P.name: Pilot Mara Quill
lines: She flies. Don't ask me how. Don't ask her either.
Pick a heading and I'll get us there. Probably in one piece.
Third coolant leak this week. That's a record. A good one.
P.title: Pilot
P.bark: Boots off the console? Make me.

kessar:done: Kessar's behind us. Good. That rock smelled like a wet dog on fire.
